thread:
maya: Heads-up — canary unpin for runtime v3.4.1 + model llm-q2 is failing in eu-west for sticky routes. saw ~6% 5xxs during the 10m window. @deploy-bot posted the event below :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary/unpin-runtime-v3.4.1 | models: llm-q2 (quant) | targets: 5% traffic eu-west | id=deploy-2024-06-14-21:34
sam: ugh, saw the 5xxs too. stack traces look like kv-cache mismatch: `kv.get: missing shard` in the runtime logs. only on long-seq requests (>1024).
kevin: confirmed in logs — seems to correlate with runtime kernel selector changing for quant path. repros locally with `--seq-len 2048` on a small cluster image.
maya: can we stop the canary and pin back the runtime in eu-west to v3.3.9 while we triage? we should preserve the model unpin state if possible.
julie: i'm +1 to pinback in region to reduce customer impact. what's the rollback command?
sam: use deployctl rollback --region eu-west --target=runtime --to=3.3.9 --preserve-model-state. quick check: `deployctl status --id deploy-2024-06-14-21:34` shows 34% of canary completed.
kevin: note — if we force rollback we lose the new kernel route for other regions; need to ensure not to affect global canary. limit scope to region.
maya: ok doing scoped rollback now. ping when done.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: rollback-1719135901 | scope=eu-west | target=runtime | to=3.3.9 | initiated_by=maya
julie: after rollback, we should pin runtime 3.3.9 for eu-west until next patch. also add a compat note in the release doc that quant-llm-q2 + runtime v3.4.1 can cause kv-cache misses on long sequences.
sam: adding to release notes draft: "Known issue: runtime v3.4.1 + quant models (llm-q2) may produce KV cache shard misses on seq_len > 1024; scheduled hotfix 3.4.2."
kevin: small repro snippet for triage (put in the incident thread):
```
# repro
python run_infer.py --model llm-q2 --seq_len 2048 --batch 1 --server eu-west
# observe kv.get errors in runtime logs
```

maya: thanks. planning: pin in eu-west until 3.4.2 patch, unblock other regions to continue canary. julie can you add the pin to deploybot pinlist?
julie: adding pin: `pinlist add region:eu-west runtime:3.3.9 until:2024-06-20 reason:"kv-cache shard mismatch with v3.4.1"` :white_check_mark:
sam: leaving a note for support: customers hitting errors get automatic fallback to older runtime in eu-west; filing a support bulletin.
maya: OK we rolled back and pinned regionally. closing the canary for eu-west. will keep monitoring global canary. thanks team :pray:
